# Vendored source

This directory contains the upstream `kysely-codegen` 0.20.0 source and
distribution files from:

https://github.com/RobinBlomberg/kysely-codegen

Pinned upstream commit: `dacb4fa` (2026-02-16).

The upstream project is MIT licensed. Its original `LICENSE` is kept beside
this file. LOC uses the existing introspector, dialect adapters, metadata model,
and serializer directly; no new package is installed.
